completionEvidence.description: Pi RPC selected mock/mock-cua, completed the screenshot -> click -> Chinese type -> enter tool loop and reached agent_settled.
The mock model log confirms the request after vm_screenshot contained the actual PNG base64 (iVBORw0KGgo), and every request exposed all five VM tools.
The guest file /tmp/aib-pi-cua-ok contained exactly '你好-pi\n'; SHA256 0cbdd51e029eee5b0b9ae43a9c38e4b7c5dfed2f8b43dc00fa07f92378707a08.
A separate slow run entered vm_wait(30000); RPC abort completed and the session settled without waiting for the full tool timeout.
After closing Pi and restarting with --session <sessionFile>, get_messages returned 15 entries versus 11 before the slow/abort sequence; history was preserved.

notes: This uses a scripted OpenAI-compatible mock, not a real LLM. It proves Pi's RPC, image, tool, abort and session mechanisms with the real guest agent. Real-model Computer Use accuracy and long-task behavior still require a credentialed validation run.
